_comment: P0-4 (HIGH-2): OS-level managed settings — the unbypassable floor. This re-asserts the critical permission denies at a path the agent cannot reach or edit (outside the repo, root-owned). Project .claude/settings.json can be checked out at an old commit or its hooks chmod -x'd; these denies cannot. The deny on Edit/Write(.claude/hooks/**) means the agent also cannot modify the hook scripts to weaken them. Place per docs/security/locks.md; do NOT rely on this file in the repo — it is a template, the live copy lives at the OS path.
